You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 18 of 50 (script duration 192.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E8: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.
E9: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
E10: When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
E11: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.
E12: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
E13: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
E14: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.
E15: When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
E16: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
E17: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
Direct lead-in to E18: Picks up directly from Episode 17's intimate hearthside moment; their peaceful sanctuary is shattered when arsonists trap Juliana and Alexander inside their burning home.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-2.1] SCREEN: Low-angle shot on the wooden floor as bright orange flames crackle beneath the closed bedroom door, thick smoke billowing through the crevices.
[L002 0.0-2.1] SFX: Muffled crackle and roar of an encroaching blaze.
[L003 2.1-5.8] SCREEN: Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.
[L004 3.5-6.0] ACTION: Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.
[L005 6.0-9.5] ACTION: Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.
[L006 6.5-8.5] JULIANA (Screaming, Terrified): "Alexander!"
[L007 9.5-12.8] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.
[L008 10.5-12.3] JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting): "Alexander!"
[L009 12.8-16.2] SCREEN: Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.
[L010 16.2-20.1] ACTION: Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.
[L011 17.8-19.8] JULIANA (Muffled, Weeping): "Alexander..."
[L012 19.5-21.0] SFX: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
[L013 20.1-22.8] SCREEN: Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.
[L014 20.8-22.5] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Urgency): "Juliana! Get up!"
[L015 22.8-26.0] SCREEN: Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.
[L016 24.5-28.9] ACTION: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.
[L017 26.5-28.0] JULIANA (Breathless, Distressed): "What happened?"
[L018 28.1-28.9] ALEXANDER (Grim, Urgent): "Fire."
[L019 28.9-30.8] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.
[L020 30.8-33.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.
[L021 32.5-36.5] ACTION: Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.
[L022 33.2-35.2] ALEXANDER (Firm, Protective): "Stay close to me."
[L023 36.5-39.0] SCREEN: Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.
[L024 38.0-41.5] ACTION: Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.
[L025 39.5-41.8] JULIANA (Panic-Stricken, Choked): "We cannot get through!"
[L026 42.0-43.5] ALEXANDER (Resolute, Calm Under Pressure): "Then we go another way."
[L027 43.5-48.8] SCREEN: Tracking shot as Alexander turns, grabbing Juliana's hand, and pulls her quickly through the burning corridors.
[L028 45.0-48.5] SFX: Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
[L029 48.8-52.5] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot focusing on Juliana's wide, soot-streaked eyes as they navigate through falling embers.
[L030 52.5-56.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the antique, leather-bound herbal ledger resting on a burning wooden table, the edges of its pages beginning to curl and singe in the heat.
[L031 56.2-58.5] ACTION: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.
[L032 56.5-57.8] JULIANA (Frantic, Desperate): "The ledger!"
[L033 57.8-60.0] ACTION: Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.
[L034 58.0-59.2] ALEXANDER (Stern, Shouting): "Leave it!"
[L035 59.3-62.5] JULIANA (Hysterical, Screaming): "No! No!"
[L036 63.0-65.5] SCREEN: Low-angle shot pointing up at the ceiling beams overhead, engulfed in roaring fire and splitting down the center.
[L037 65.5-68.0] ACTION: Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.
[L038 65.8-68.0] ALEXANDER (Loud, Alarmed): "Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!"
[L039 68.0-70.5] ACTION: Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.
[L040 70.5-73.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards with a fiery explosion.
[L041 73.5-75.5] ALEXANDER (Roaring in Terror): "Juliana!"
[L042 75.0-76.8] JULIANA (Defiant, Weeping): "It's my mother's!"
[L043 76.8-81.5] ACTION: Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.
[L044 81.5-83.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the ceiling rafter splitting violently apart above her.
[L045 83.5-86.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up in sheer terror, firelight dancing across her tearful face.
[L046 84.0-86.2] JULIANA (Screaming, Blood-Curdling): "Alexander!"
[L047 86.5-89.5] ACTION: Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.
[L048 86.5-87.5] ALEXANDER (Screaming Command): "Down!"
[L049 87.8-90.0] SFX: Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.
[L050 89.5-94.0] SCREEN: Ground-level shot of Alexander lying on top of Juliana, his chest shielding her, his face smeared with soot.
[L051 91.5-98.0] ACTION: Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.
[L052 96.5-98.2] ALEXANDER (Panting, Reassuring): "I've got you."
[L053 98.5-101.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of the walls collapsing in curtains of flame, cutting off all interior hallways.
[L054 101.5-104.5] ACTION: Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.
[L055 103.5-105.5] ACTION: Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.
[L056 103.8-105.0] JULIANA (Urgent, Shouting): "The window!"
[L057 105.2-106.8] ALEXANDER (Steely, Determined): "Hold on to me."
[L058 106.8-109.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.
[L059 109.5-114.0] SCREEN: Slow-motion shot as Alexander sprints through the burning room toward the framed glass window.
[L060 111.5-115.5] ACTION: Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.
[L061 112.0-115.5] SFX: Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.
[L062 115.5-119.8] SCREEN: Wide interior shot as the entire parlor collapses into an uncontrollable inferno of roaring flames.
[L063 119.8-124.0] SCREEN: Night exterior shot in the dark grass outside. Juliana sits over Alexander, brushing ashes from his face as he coughs and catches his breath.
[L064 124.0-128.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of villagers running toward the cottage carrying wooden water buckets through the smoke-filled darkness.
[L065 128.5-134.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud, her face blackened with soot and tears streaming down her cheeks as she clutches the charred ledger.
[L066 134.5-140.0] SCREEN: Wide shot of the cottage completely consumed by towering flames against the dark night sky.
[L067 136.2-138.0] JULIANA (Sobbing, Heartbroken): "Our home..."
[L068 139.8-142.5] JULIANA (Crying, Shattered): "Everything we had is gone."
[L069 140.5-144.0] ACTION: Alexander kneels beside her in the grass, resting a steady, protective hand on her back.
[L070 144.0-155.0] ACTION: Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.
[L071 145.8-148.5] JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Anguished): "Why would anyone do this?"
[L072 153.2-154.8] JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful): "Alexander..."
[L073 155.0-161.0] ACTION: Alexander draws her firmly into his arms, wrapping both burly arms around her as she buries her face into his shoulder, weeping uncontrollably.
[L074 158.0-160.8] ALEXANDER (Cold, Ominous): "Someone wanted us out."
[L075 163.0-165.5] JULIANA (Despairing, Weeping): "We have nowhere to go."
[L076 165.5-171.0] SCREEN: Slow push-in on Alexander's face over Juliana's shoulder. His expression hardens into a mask of pure, lethal fury.
[L077 171.0-179.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Alexander's piercing eyes and combat scar bathed in the flickering orange glow of the fire.
[L078 171.8-177.2] ALEXANDER (Cold Fury, Resolute): "They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now."
[L079 179.5-184.0] ACTION: Juliana slowly pulls back slightly from his embrace, her tear-filled blue eyes looking up into his hardened features.
[L080 184.2-186.5] JULIANA (Trembling, Apprehensive): "What are you going to do?"
[L081 186.5-192.0] SCREEN: Dramatic hold on Alexander's grim, unyielding profile as he stares into the inferno with unshakeable resolve, the swelling score echoing a vow of vengeance into the final cut to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:

    }
  ]
}

I will not let them take anything else now.", "why_it_works": "The rapid escalation from waking up to a burning house to a narrow escape keeps the viewer glued to the screen.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 10}]}

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good.
